sentences.text:
Bench: Vivek Agarwal  1   IN THE HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH  AT JABALPUR  CRR No. 913 of 2024  (GANPAT KUSHWAHA Vs THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH AND  Dated : 09-04-2025  Shri Pradeep Kumar Naveriya - Advocate for the applican  Shri Manas Mani Verma - Government Advocate for the  respondents/State.
On going through the judgment of the learned Special Judge, POCSO Act Teekamgarh namely Smt.
Jyoti Rajput passed in Special Case No.36/2019, we find that appellant Santosh Kushwaha has been convicted under Section 450 of IPC and sentenced to undergo R.I. for five years with fine of Rs.500/- with default stipulation of one month R.I.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH  AT JABALPUR  CRR No. 913 of 2024
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Thereafter, learned Special Judge has mentioned that appellant-Santosh is convicted under Section 376(2)(i) of IPC and sentenced to undergo R.I. for ten years with fine of Rs.10,000/- with default stipulation of two months R.I.

Similarly, he has been convicted under Section 506 (part-II) of IPC and sentenced to undergo R.I.
for two years with fine of Rs.200/- with default stipulation of fifteen days R.I.

Thereafter, learned Special Judge has mentioned that appellant, offence under Section 4 of the POCSO Act, 2012 being included in the offence under Section 376(2)(i) of IPC, therefore, he is not being punished separately.

On perusal of IPC, it reveals that Section 376(2)(i) was amended vide Criminal Act, 22 of 2018,
Section 4(b) w.r.e.f. 21.04.2018.

Thereafter, sub- section 3 was inserted in place of clause (i) of sub-section 2 of Section 376 2 CRR-913-2024 of IPC which reads as under 376(3) - "whoever,
commits rape of a woman under sixteen years of age shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment for a term which shall not be less than twenty years, but which may extend to imprisonment for life,
which shall mean imprisonment for the remainder of that person's natural life, and shall also be liable to fine:
Provided that such fine shall be just and reasonable to meet the medical expenses and rehabilitation of the victim:
Provided further that any fine imposed under this sub-section shall be paid to the victim."

sentences.text: 1 In para 12 of the impugned judgment, trial Court recorded a finding that victim was less than 16 years of age.

Therefore, it appears that it escaped notice of the trial Court that provisions contained in Section 376(2)(i) since stood omitted w.r.e.f. 21.04.2018 and admittedly,
alleged offence was committed on 03.11.2018.
Therefore, provisions of Section 376(2)(i) of IPC will not be applicable, rather, provisions of Section 376(3) will be applicable in terms of the finding of the trial Court that the victim was less than 16 years of age.
In view of such facts, issue notice to the accused-Santosh Kushwaha respondent No.2.
Notice is waived by Shri Pradeep Naveriya and prays for time to seek instructions and argue this case.

In the meanwhile, Registrar General is directed to issue notice to Smt. Jyoti Rajput seeking her explanation in regard to her judgment in Special Case No.36/2019 State of M.P. through SHO,
Police Station Baldeogarh Vs. Santosh Kushwaha on the aforesaid aspect.
3 CRR-913-2024 List this case on 22.04.2025.
